summary: All three v10 SHOULD-FIX findings are repaired: reviewer-colliding ids are uniquely qualified, Codex V9-A1 receives a successor correction without rewriting history, and the carried-advisory register is restored. The frozen corpus pin resolves without retarget, all 26 minimal v10-to-v11 paths are named, and the lock and authority contracts are unchanged. One placement concern remains advisory-grade.

advisories.title: Corpus advancement policy is attached to the unrelated OD-2 lock-shape decision
advisories.detail: OD-2's decision is whether TC-ACCEPT/TC-SIG/TC-BYTE-EXACT lock deferral should be normalized into one conditionalRequires shape. V11 adds corpusAdvance to that object, defining how the frozen fixture-corpus draft may move to a later schema. The policy itself is clear and is also repeated in appliesFindingsOf.standing, but its ownership has no semantic relationship to OD-2. A later successor should place corpus-advance custody in a dedicated fixture-citation/custody field or named decision, then cross-reference it if needed, so resolving OD-2 cannot accidentally remove an unrelated freeze rule.
advisories.notBlocking: The current rule is explicit, the corpus digest resolves, the file was not retargeted, appliesFindingsOf.standing independently preserves the rule, and no acceptance or implementation authority is granted.
